world: ANES Time Series Cumulative Data File, four-object menu (secondary world). Variable names from the ICPSR 8475 codebook (1948-2000 edition, Stanford SSDS mirror). Placement codes 1-7 valid with 0, 8, 9 missing are the standard for these scales and MUST be confirmed against the current codebook before sealing.
notes: Three-scale variant for a sensitivity run after the sealed two-scale run: add aid to blacks (VCF9084, VCF9092, VCF0517, VCF0518, VCF9076). Never change scales after sealing; a variant is a new registration.
